column1: # ================= A. THE COMPENSATION FILES — THE LARGEST UNOPENED SEAM =================

column2: *** ENTSCHÄDIGUNGSAKTE FOR KURT LUWINSKI, Landesarchiv Berlin. *** West Germany paid compensation to Jewish refugees under the Bundesentschädigungsgesetz from 1953, and claims were filed FROM ABROAD in their thousands. Kurt left Germany in 1933 and lived in Johannesburg until 1969 — exactly the profile of a claimant. AN ENTSCHÄDIGUNGSAKTE IS THE RICHEST SINGLE DOCUMENT THIS FAMILY COULD HAVE: it contains the applicant's OWN SWORN ACCOUNT of what he lost and when he left, his Berlin addresses, his trade, his schooling, his foreign address, and usually affidavits from people who knew him. The Entschädigungsbehörde files are held at the LANDESARCHIV BERLIN (B Rep. 025) and are indexed by name. COST: one letter. OWNER: this archive drafts, David sends.

THE SAME FOR AUGUSTE AND SIEGFRIED. Auguste survived in Berlin as the Catholic wife of a deported Jewish husband — a Mischehe, with "collective" persecution on her census card — and Siegfried survived as her son. Both had claims. SIEGFRIED'S WOULD BE FILED FROM EAST GERMANY OR NOT AT ALL, which is itself an answer about which side of the wall he chose and when.

RÜCKERSTATTUNG — THE RESTITUTION OF THE BUSINESS. "JAQUES LEIBHOLZ & CO, KONFEKTION, W8 KRONENSTRASSE 59.60" is in the 1938 directory and gone afterwards. A liquidated Jewish firm generates a property-restitution file at the WIEDERGUTMACHUNGSÄMTER VON BERLIN. Those files name the owners, the value, the "Aryanising" purchaser and the post-war claimants — and the claimants are the surviving family, which is the list this archive most wants.

column1: # ================= B. AUSTRALIA — A WHOLE BRANCH, ENTIRELY WORKED =================

column2: *** NATIONAL ARCHIVES OF AUSTRALIA, RecordSearch — free, online, name-indexed. *** Manfred Luwinski flew Berlin to Melbourne in 1965 as an ASSISTED MIGRANT. Assisted migrants generate a MIGRANT SELECTION DOCUMENT (series A2478, A12111 and kin) holding the application, the photograph, the trade test and the nominator. THE ICEM ROLL GAVE THE FLIGHT. THIS WOULD GIVE THE MAN.

NAA NATURALISATION. A German national naturalising in Australia in the late 1960s or 1970s leaves a file, and naturalisations were GAZETTED in the Commonwealth of Australia Gazette — which is free and full-text.

TROVE — free, full-text, and never used by this archive. Australian newspapers, gazettes and directories in one search. Copyright closes most newspapers at 1954, BUT THE GAZETTES RUN ON, and death and funeral notices for MANFRED (Brisbane, 20 September 2012) sit outside Trove in the Courier-Mail's own archive.

QUEENSLAND REGISTRY OF BIRTHS DEATHS AND MARRIAGES. Manfred died at Brisbane on 20 September 2012. The Queensland historical index is free to search; a death certificate names PARENTS, and Manfred's parents are exactly what the tree gets wrong — it makes him the son of Alfred Luwinski of Przasnysz, who died at Sachsenhausen in 1942 and was a Polish Catholic farm labourer.

AUSTRALIAN ELECTORAL ROLLS, 1965 to 1980, for LUWINSKI and for MARQUARDT. They give address and occupation year by year, and they would track the family from Melbourne to Canberra to Brisbane — the three places the ICEM roll and the death together imply.

*** THE OTHER THREE PEOPLE ON THE FLIGHT. *** The ICEM nominal roll, BGO 65/135, carries the family group at LINES 85 TO 88. Four people flew, not one. Whoever the other three are, they are the Australian branch and none of them has been traced.

H. MARQUARDT OF MELBOURNE, the man Manfred was consigned to. The tree holds HELGA ERNA MARQUARDT WAGNER NÉE LUWINSKI, born 1934 — a Luwinski who married a Marquardt. THE SPONSOR IS ALMOST CERTAINLY THE BROTHER-IN-LAW, and finding him finds when the FIRST of them went out.

column1: # ================= C. SOUTH AFRICA — KURT'S OWN THIRTY-SIX YEARS =================

column2: *** KURT'S NATURALISATION FILE. *** A German Jew who arrived in 1933, traded under his own name from 1941 and died a South African in 1969 will have naturalised, and South African naturalisation files are indexed in NAAIRS and gazetted in the Government Gazette. THE FILE WOULD GIVE HIS ARRIVAL DATE, HIS SHIP AND HIS DECLARED PLACE OF BIRTH — three things this archive has never had for him.

ALIEN REGISTRATION AND THE WAR. Kurt was a GERMAN NATIONAL IN SOUTH AFRICA FROM 1939 TO 1945. German nationals were registered, restricted and in some cases interned; a Jewish refugee would ordinarily be exempted, and THE EXEMPTION ITSELF IS A DOCUMENT. Justice Department and Interior series at the National Archives, Pretoria.

THE PICCADILLY HAT COMPANY. He bought it on 1 November 1941 and was still there in 1952. A trading name generates a REGISTER OF BUSINESS NAMES entry for the Transvaal — proprietors, addresses, dates of commencement and cessation. Different records from the gazette notices already read.

JOHANNESBURG CITY DIRECTORIES — Longland's, and Donaldson & Braby's. The Berlin address books have been the single most productive instrument in this whole archive. JOHANNESBURG HAS THE SAME KIND OF BOOK AND NOBODY HAS OPENED IT. It would place Kurt's shop and his home, year by year, from 1933 to 1969.

GAZETTES.AFRICA FOR NATURALISATION AND CHANGE OF NAME. The site is free, full-text, and already used for the hat shop. It has not been searched for naturalisation notices, nor for the seven spellings of the surname in that specific context.

column1: # ================= D. EAST PRUSSIA — WHERE THEY CAME FROM =================

column2: *** GENETEKA, WARMIŃSKO-MAZURSKIE (14wm), FOR LUWINSKI AND THIMM. *** The province code bug was found and fixed today and the Szubin searches were re-run — BUT EAST PRUSSIA WAS NEVER SEARCHED AT ALL. Allenstein is Olsztyn and Sauerbaum is in Kreis Rössel; both are in 14wm. Joachim Luwinski was born at Allenstein on 21 October 1865 and Johanna Thimm at Sauerbaum on 25 March 1871. THIS IS A FREE SEARCH THAT TAKES TEN MINUTES AND HAS NEVER BEEN RUN.

ARCHIWUM PAŃSTWOWE W OLSZTYNIE. The Standesamt registers for Allenstein and the Rössel district from 1874, and the Catholic registers before that. Lizzy was born at Sauerbaum in 1893, inside civil registration — HER BIRTH RECORD WOULD NAME JOACHIM AND JOHANNA AND SETTLE THE GENERATION ABOVE HER.

SAUERBAUM'S MODERN POLISH NAME, established once and written down. Every Polish archive, index and portal is organised by the current name, and this archive has been searching a German one. THE ONE-LINE ANSWER UNLOCKS EVERY OTHER POLISH ROUTE FOR THIS SIDE OF THE FAMILY.

column1: # ================= E. THE GERMAN END, AFTER THE WALL =================

column2: LANDESARCHIV BERLIN — THE FULL EINWOHNERMELDEKARTEI. The card this archive read at Arolsen is one survivor of a city-wide registration system. THE LANDESARCHIV HOLDS THE SERIES, and its cards carry the whole address history that the Arolsen scan is too poor to read — which is also the answer to row 198.

SIEGFRIED'S SIDE, AND IT NEEDS CARE. Siegfried Leibholz died in 2005 and is buried at the Südwest-Kirchhof Stahnsdorf; his son Michael Kurt died the same year at Ludwigsfelde. THE CEMETERY REGISTER IS AN ORDINARY GENEALOGICAL RECORD AND THE REST IS NOT. There are living relatives on that side and the archive's own rule applies: the burial can be recorded, the circumstances of 2005 are already in the family's own tree and do not need repeating on a public page.

column1: # AND ONE THING THAT IS NOT ON THE LIST, BECAUSE IT CANNOT WORK.
# DNA WILL NEVER CONFIRM A LUWINSKI. Derrick does not descend from Kurt, so no test of his can reach
# this family. The Luwinskis can be documented and they cannot be proved by blood from this side.
# The only DNA route is a LUWINSKI DESCENDANT testing — and two of them are living and are not to be
# approached by this archive.
# *** AND A RULE THAT APPLIES TO ALL TWENTY, ADDED BY DAVID THE SAME DAY. ***
# TRY EVERY SPELLING, EVERY TIME. The archive's own name work records SEVEN forms of this surname —
# LUWINSKI, LUWINSKY, LUWENSKI, LUWWINSKY, LOWINSKI, LOWINSKY, JUWINSKI — and four of LEIBHOLZ:
# LEIBHOLZ, LAIBHOLZ, LEIBBHOLZ, LEIBHOLTZ. Item 16 was run on one spelling and returned one woman
# in one village. Run on the list, one at a time and exact, the SAME INDEX returned a household in
